prompt: Create ONE wide LANDSCAPE 16:9 fine architectural ink-and-watercolour illustration on warm cream art paper. This is a new distinct candidate in the approved Artemis Atlantic Heritage Watercolour series, using the attached image as a STYLE AND BUILDING-FAMILY reference, not a scene to copy. Hand-drawn dark sepia nib, delicate precise cross-hatching, transparent layered watercolor washes, limestone cream/ochre, volcanic basalt grey, restrained bronze, natural greens, quiet Atlantic blue-grey. Airy unfinished vignette edges, sophisticated calm composition, soft natural light. No photorealism or computer 3D, no people, no text, captions, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, amphorae, deeds or money. No exact parcel, approved architectural plan, guaranteed amenity or documentary project-progress claim. One landscape illustration only. A modest covered terrace as a quiet living-space concept: one simple Spanish column, warm cream rendered wall, small wooden table and two woven chairs, green private garden and basalt paving. Looking out from the shade, with cool Atlantic daylight and only a muted distant blue-grey hint. No swimming pool, no resort scene or guaranteed view.
rights_basis: New concept illustration from approved project style reference; public-use clearance remains pending
